params.name: ad_account_id
params.description: Unique identifier of an ad account.

params.name: test
params.description:
Include query param ?test=true to mark the request as a test request. The events will not be recorded but the API will still return the same response messages. Use this mode to verify your requests are working and your events are constructed correctly.
Warning: If you use this query parameter, be certain that it is off (set to false or deleted) before sending a legitimate (non-testing) request.

items.docs: The Pinterest API offers advertisers a way to send Pinterest their conversion information (including web conversions, in-app conversions, or even offline conversions) based on their ad_account_id. The request body should be a JSON object. - This endpoint requires an access_token be generated through Ads Manager.
